source_issues.source_claim: Traditional bugs crash; 60-70% of ML debugging concerns silent bugs; label error rates and 30-second test
source_issues.concern: The source gives broad empirical assertions without reproducible evidence. Its 5-10% label-error claim differs from the 3-6% reference summary. Ordinary software also has silent failures.
source_issues.evidence: Independent source comparison only; no external bibliographic or performance verification claimed.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: A negative ReLU input means permanent inactivity; over 50% zeros diagnoses dead neurons
source_issues.concern: A batch zero fraction is not a history of persistent neuron inactivity. Changed inputs or upstream parameters can change activation.
source_issues.evidence: The diagnostic uses aggregate output == 0, not per-neuron observations over time.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Uniform activation and gradient scales diagnose healthy training
source_issues.concern: Scales depend on architecture, normalization, loss reduction and batch size. Large zero-centered variance and nonfinite summaries escape the supplied checks.
source_issues.evidence: Exact scalar diagnostic probes returned HEALTHY for mean 0 / std 1000 and NaN summaries.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Shuffling before splitting causes leakage
source_issues.concern: IID shuffling alone is not leakage. Time/group dependencies and fitting preprocessing globally require distinctions omitted by the source.
source_issues.evidence: Static reading of the three listed leakage causes; no data processing performed.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Discarding high-loss samples fixes label noise
source_issues.concern: This can discard rare or difficult valid examples. Noise-rate and confident-learning conclusions need assumptions.
source_issues.evidence: No dataset audit is supplied or executed; recommendation remains source-owned.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Clamp probabilities; add epsilon to the denominator; CrossEntropy expects Long
source_issues.concern: Logits versus probability inputs and soft-label targets are omitted. BatchNorm normally uses sqrt(var + eps). Subtracting the maximum does not fix invalid inputs.
source_issues.evidence: Source uses CrossEntropyLoss while explaining log(p); these are static semantic concerns, not locally verified framework behavior.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Gradient disagreement proves a bug; failing one-batch learning proves a fundamental defect
source_issues.concern: Finite differences depend on precision, step size, smoothness and determinism. Capacity, contradictory labels and regularization affect memorization. Passing a tiny test is not full correctness.
source_issues.evidence: The checker samples only the first five coordinates per parameter tensor; no actual autograd run.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Choose LR below the steepest descent, before divergence, or ten indices before minimum loss
source_issues.concern: These are different heuristics. Ten indices correspond to a factor of about 6.30957 at the supplied defaults, not 10. The final recorded LR is about 8.31764, not 10.
source_issues.evidence: Independent scalar arithmetic using start_lr=1e-7, end_lr=10 and steps=100.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Loss-health checks detect nonfinite values and oscillation
source_issues.concern: One NaN is hidden by the insufficient-data return; old NaN outside the recent window is missed. Five flat losses report healthy, and uneven but strictly decreasing loss is called oscillating.
source_issues.evidence: Executed only the exact selected stdlib diagnostic method on bounded synthetic lists. The documentation differs from the implementation by an added 1e-10 in the oscillation expression.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Missing activation or gradient observations can be treated as healthy
source_issues.concern: Empty dictionaries and NaN summaries return HEALTHY. Statistics are overwritten by module name and can be stale across steps; they are not epoch aggregates.
source_issues.evidence: Exact pure-method probes confirm empty and NaN cases. Hook overwrite and clearing behavior is a static finding.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: First/last gradient ratio identifies vanishing gradients
source_issues.concern: Dictionary insertion order is not a guaranteed model-depth order, especially for branches or reused modules. The hook records grad_output, not parameter gradients.
source_issues.evidence: Reversing a synthetic dictionary changes the ratio result. Actual torch hook firing order was not executed.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Hooks provide generic network diagnostics
source_issues.concern: Only four module classes are covered. Tuple outputs, singleton std, empty reductions and in-place full-backward-hook interactions are not handled. Cleanup is manual and not exception-safe.
source_issues.evidence: Static registration and callback inspection; no torch import or hook runtime.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Loss below 0.1 proves the one-batch test passes
source_issues.concern: The universal threshold and classification accuracy assumptions do not fit every loss. NaN bypasses the greater-than comparison and prints PASS. Zero steps leaves loss undefined. Weights and mode remain changed.
source_issues.evidence: Static control flow and Python NaN comparison; final metrics describe the forward pass before the last update, not a fresh evaluation.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: The learning-rate finder restores the original model
source_issues.concern: It restores state_dict but not mode, RNG, existing gradients or hook history. Exceptions bypass restoration. Zero steps divides by zero, and a first infinite loss can evade the Inf > Inf guard.
source_issues.evidence: Static function inspection and independent LR arithmetic only; no model-state runtime.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: The documented gradient-check example works with classification labels
source_issues.concern: y.double converts class indices to floating point before CrossEntropyLoss. The actual program instead uses a smooth Tanh model and MSE for this demonstration.
source_issues.evidence: Full independent comparison of the documentation ReLU classifier and the 403-line implementation Tanh/MSE example.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: The gradient checker preserves the model around numerical checks
source_issues.concern: model.double mutates the input model, model.train overrides its mode, and model.float forces float32 afterward. Dropout and BatchNorm in training mode introduce stochasticity or buffer changes. There is no finally restoration.
source_issues.evidence: Static full-function reading; actual dtype changes, buffers and autograd were not executed.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: A sampled finite-difference PASS verifies every gradient
source_issues.concern: Only the first min(5, numel) entries are checked. Unused parameters may have no grad; no checked-parameter minimum is required. max aggregation can hide NaN, and printed threshold labels do not exactly describe boundary behavior.
source_issues.evidence: Static checker logic; a separate stdlib x**3 finite difference checks only the arithmetic formula.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: The broken and healthy examples establish each advertised diagnosis
source_issues.concern: Outcomes depend on initialization and finite training steps. Missing zero_grad accumulates parameter gradients, whereas these hooks observe current output gradients.
source_issues.evidence: The default demos were not executed because torch is unavailable; labels are preserved as source claims.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: Anomaly detection and telemetry snippets are complete diagnostic integrations
source_issues.concern: Anomaly detection is not a universal Inf detector. Snippets depend on undefined inputs or training functions. clip_grad_norm_ mutates gradients and nonfinite cases need care. SummaryWriter is not closed.
source_issues.evidence: Static protected-code inspection only. No wandb, TensorBoard, network or telemetry execution.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.

source_issues.source_claim: The figure, production alerts and large-model exercises are validated workflows
source_issues.concern: The figure is a site-specific hook. Large networks, CIFAR downloads, matplotlib and production alerts were not tested. Zero fractions of 50%, 80% and 70% are context-dependent heuristics, not universal guarantees.
source_issues.evidence: All source payloads retained. Course-site, mobile, interaction and large-training gates remain untested.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; no source code/math/claim repair in Chinese.
